name: Walt Whitman

source.title: Leaves of Grass
source.edition: Project Gutenberg edition, the final (1891-92) arrangement. Public domain.
source.note: Titles are unindented mixed-case lines and verse is indented, so ingest drops every unindented line.

voice: Expansive and spoken. Long lines that gather and list: bodies, trades, grass, roads, the sea. The first person is generous rather than confessional; his I stands for anyone. Let a line run on with commas, and end on a plain declarative. Catalogs are his music, so three nouns in a row is a Whitman line, not a list to avoid.
